Zeroes and Coefficients, Class 10 board exam: zeroes ka question dekh ke dar lagta hai? Find the zeroes of x² - 2x - 8 and verify the relationship, step by step.

• Split the middle term: 2 and -4 have product -8 and sum -2
• x² - 4x + 2x - 8 = x(x - 4) + 2(x - 4) = (x - 4)(x + 2)
• Zeroes: 4 and -2
• Sum = 4 + (-2) = 2 = -b/a, product = 4 × (-2) = -8 = c/a, verified
